name.ja: 1/144 ヴァルヴレイヴV 火打羽

description.ja: • 難攻不落の盾をまとう防御タイプの５号機。パイロットは犬塚キューマ。
description.en: • Unit 5 is a defensive type that wears an impregnable shield. The pilot is Kyuma Inuzuka.

description.ja: • 「ボルト・ファランクス」用の硬質残光エフェクトパーツが付属。両前腕部に装着し、劇中の射出シーンを再現できる。
description.en: • Hard afterglow effect parts for "Bolt Phalanx" are included. By attaching it to both forearms, you can recreate the ejection scene from the movie.

description.ja: • あらゆる防御性能を合わせもつ特能装備「IMP」はクリアパーツで質感と共に再現。
description.en: • The special equipment "IMP" that has all kinds of defensive performance is reproduced with clear parts and texture.

description.ja: • 接着剤不要。組立ててシールを貼るだけでカラフルに仕上がる。成形品×20、ホイルシール×1、組立説明書×1
description.en: • No adhesive required. Just assemble and apply the seal to create a colorful finish. Molded product x 20, foil seal x 1, assembly manual x 1
